diagnosticPreflight.requirement: Confirm all declared executables are ordinary executable files before evidence collection; do not incorporate diagnostic stdout or stderr into evidence.

identitySnapshot.xattrValueTransport: native xattr -p raw stdout bytes captured without text decoding

chunkTransport.terminalRule: display exactly one declared content chunk per terminal result; diagnostics and hash results must be separate terminal results
chunkTransport.reconstructionRule: append each private chunk through explicit ordered no-wildcard reads and verify reconstructed byte count plus SHA-256 against the original input binding
chunkTransport.truncationControl: No command may emit more than one maximum-3072-byte content chunk to the terminal; content and verification outputs are never combined.
forbidden: multiple content chunks in one terminal result
LF or CR escaped shell-variable byte accounting
